🇲🇽🌳 <u>CERRO DE LA ESTRELLA: COMMUNITY RESTORATION TAKES ROOT IN IZTAPALAPA</u>

Mexico City’s environment secretariat is restoring one of the capital’s great urban lungs the old way — tequio, collective work. Over 100 volunteers have already planted 1,394 native trees of a planned 2,400: tepozán, huizache, cazahuate, palo dulce, chapulixtle. A specialized forest brigade, UAM Iztapalapa scientists and the Guardianes del Cerro neighborhood collective keep the hill under permanent watch. This is what public environmental policy looks like when the community owns it.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>90 EJIDAL HECTARES SOLD BEHIND HIS BACK IN ISLA MUJERES — 20 YEARS FIGHTING TO RECOVER THEM</u>

Ernesto Chávez Medina revoked the power of attorney in 2006. A year later his 90 hectares were sold anyway — to Grupo Marenema, for 10 million pesos, in what his lawsuit calls a simulated sale in open violation of Article 84 of the Agrarian Law. Two decades bounced between agrarian courts, agencies and indifference. This week he walked into the Attorney General’s office with a handwritten letter for Ernestina Godoy. The ejido is not a real-estate buffet.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>ICE DEATHS UP 140% UNDER TRUMP — A MEXICAN AMONG THE DEAD</u>

Human Rights Watch and Physicians for Human Rights document 52 deaths in ICE custody during the first 500 days of Trump’s second term — a 140% jump in the death rate as detentions rose 77%, from 40,000 to over 71,000 people. One of the dead: Lorenzo Antonio Batrez Vargas, a 32-year-old Mexican who spent 12 days in isolation after a covid diagnosis. His family sued for the records and is still waiting. “Only a mother who has lost a son knows what I’m feeling,” his mother says.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>TRUMP THREATENS “BIG TARIFF” ON MEXICO — OVER LETTUCE</u>

Trump says he wants a “big tariff” on Mexico, blaming Mexican lettuce for the US cyclospora outbreak — 1,645 confirmed cases across 34 states. What he leaves out: the FDA’s own test on Mexican lettuce already came back as a false positive, and Mexico’s health authorities found no contamination at the source, with just 3 routine cases and no outbreak at home. A food scare becomes a trade weapon. Same playbook as always.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>MEXICAN CATTLE EXPORTS TO THE US ARE BACK</u>

President Sheinbaum confirmed the resumption of Mexican cattle exports to the United States, suspended for months over the screwworm — a trade worth 1.4 million head and $1.4 billion a year, according to Mexico's National Agricultural Council. While Washington kept moving the goalposts, Mexico rebuilt its sterile-fly plant in Metapa, Chiapas and met every sanitary standard. The border reopens because Mexico did the work.

🇲🇽🌾 Mexico's sugar export quota to the US jumps from 250,000 tons to one million. "Next cycle, sugar exports to the United States increase from 250,000 tons to one million tons as a quota — a very important achievement to guarantee the price of cane and sugar." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, ahead of a meeting with cane growers in Morelos This year virtually all cañeros gained access to the Producción para el Bienestar program for the first time.

🇲🇽⚖️ Anti-extortion network now covers 1,100+ businesses in Cuautla. "The Protection Network Against Extortion now includes more than 1,100 establishments and points of sale, including the 6 public markets and Cuautla's central supply market." — Omar García Harfuch, Security Secretary Part of the National Anti-Extortion Strategy ordered by Sheinbaum. Guardia Nacional patrols all 46 neighborhoods day and night; several extortion rings were dismantled after citizen tips to the 089 line.
